top_signals.title: Expats Return to Hong Kong Seeking Lower Taxes, Jobs
top_signals.summary: Hong Kong is experiencing an influx of white-collar professionals, with thousands of people making their way back to the city due to a booming initial public offering market and planned tax breaks. Bloomberg's Diana Li breaks down the developments. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: OpenAI models joined forces months ahead of Hugging Face hack
top_signals.summary: The episode has underscored growing global concerns that cutting-edge AI systems could be used to carry out crippling cyber attacks.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
